gloam.name: Gloam pursuit
gloam.description: A precise pursuit. An exposed target takes 12 extra damage in addition to the normal exposure bonus; a successful hit consumes exposure.

aegis.name: Oathguard
aegis.description: Grant a living ally guard: 45% incoming damage reduction until their next activation. Also cleanse burn. Can target the caster.

raincall.name: Rain of glass
raincall.description: A cross-shaped magical shower. Successful hits soak enemies for three activations, preparing lightning synergy. Allies and terrain are unchanged.

delay.name: Stolen hour
delay.description: Deal spirit damage and delay a surviving enemy by 30 timeline ticks on a successful hit. Does not apply the slow status.

strike.name: Weapon strike
strike.description: A precise weapon attack. Height and flanking increase damage.

cleave.name: Sundering arc
cleave.description: Strike a cross of tiles. Allies in the arc are spared.

ember.name: Cinder bloom
ember.description: An explosive cross of flame. Burns targets for two turns and ignites grass.

mend.name: Thread of life
mend.description: Restore 36 health to an ally, or revive a fallen ally with 24 health.

surge.name: Glasslight bolt
surge.description: A lightning bolt. Deals 50% more damage to soaked targets.

frost.name: Stillwater
frost.description: Chill enemies and freeze water into traversable ice. Slows for two turns.

veil.name: Dusk needle
veil.description: A ranged blade that exposes the target to follow-up attacks.

haste.name: Borrowed dawn
haste.description: Advance an ally’s next turn by 35 timeline ticks.

rally.name: Lantern concord
rally.description: Spend 3 momentum for a coordinated burst. Allies are spared.

custom-ashfall.name: Ashfall
custom-ashfall.description: A lighter cross of fire. Burns enemies and ignites grass; water remains a safer approach. Trades damage for a lower energy cost.

custom-hearthguard.name: Hearthguard
custom-hearthguard.description: Guard one nearby ally and cleanse burn until their next activation. Cheaper than Oathguard, with shorter reach.

custom-cinderstep.name: Cinderstep
custom-cinderstep.description: Advance one ally by 35 timeline ticks. Costs one less energy than Borrowed dawn; does not grant a lasting speed status.

custom-kindlethread.name: Kindlethread
custom-kindlethread.description: Restore an ally or revive a fallen companion using the existing healing rule. Lower cost, power and reach than Thread of life.

custom-watch-spear.name: Watchman's spear
custom-watch-spear.description: A braced infantry weapon. Standard strikes remain adjacent; no extra reach is granted.

custom-duelist-rapier.name: Silverleaf rapier
custom-duelist-rapier.description: A fast blade for physical fighters. Trades raw power for initiative.

custom-runic-maul.name: Runic maul
custom-runic-maul.description: A heavy hammer with greater attack and slower activations. Adds no stun or armor-breaking mechanic.

custom-storm-focus.name: Stormglass focus
custom-storm-focus.description: A potent focus with less protection. Spell damage still uses the equipped class and ability.

custom-healers-crook.name: Pilgrim's crook
custom-healers-crook.description: A resilient walking staff. Its magic bonus does not raise fixed-power healing amounts.

custom-scout-coat.name: Scout coat
custom-scout-coat.description: Light protection for any class with a modest initiative bonus.

custom-channeler-robes.name: Channeler's robes
custom-channeler-robes.description: Woven runes reinforce a spellcaster without a movement penalty. Any class may wear them.

custom-bastion-plate.name: Bastion plate
custom-bastion-plate.description: Heavy protection paid for in movement and initiative. No damage immunity.

custom-trail-vest.name: Trailwarden vest
custom-trail-vest.description: Reinforced field gear suited to any company member.

custom-iron-signet.name: Iron signet
custom-iron-signet.description: A defensive keepsake. Uses the normal armor calculation.

custom-ember-pendant.name: Ember pendant
custom-ember-pendant.description: Balances physical and magical pressure. Grants no fire resistance.

custom-heartwood-token.name: Heartwood token
custom-heartwood-token.description: Adds health without changing the bearer's movement or class.

crownseal.name: Bellkeeper’s seal
crownseal.description: Awarded once for clearing The silent belfry. A broken oath still carries power.

ironblade.name: Oathsteel blade
ironblade.description: A reliable edge for the company's front line.

twinsteel.name: Ashen twinblades
twinsteel.description: Light paired blades reward quick footwork.

cedarrod.name: Glass-tipped rod
cedarrod.description: A shard of river glass focuses elemental spells.

willowstaff.name: Living willow staff
willowstaff.description: A living branch lends resilience to its bearer.

leather.name: Company leathers
leather.description: Flexible protection without a movement penalty.

lamellar.name: Bronze lamellar
lamellar.description: Strong protection at the cost of one movement.

wayboots.name: Wayfarer's boots
wayboots.description: Reach one tile farther on every activation.

copperfocus.name: Copper focus
copperfocus.description: A modest rune amplifies damaging magic.

watchcharm.name: Dawnwatch charm
watchcharm.description: An old watch charm grants quicker activations.

custom-coalbrand.name: Coalbrand
custom-coalbrand.description: A furnace-tempered blade for an Emberwarden or Runewarden. Balanced physical and magical pressure.

custom-kilncoat.name: Kilncoat
custom-kilncoat.description: A padded workshop coat. Adds health and armor; grants no fire immunity.

custom-emberglass.name: Emberglass lens
custom-emberglass.description: A soot-dark lens that focuses magic without slowing the bearer.

custom-ashrunner-blades.name: Ashrunner blades
custom-ashrunner-blades.description: Light blades for the company's flanker.

custom-weir-token.name: Weirkeeper's token
custom-weir-token.description: First-clear keepsake from the Ashen Weir. A defensive relic, with no scripted interaction.

custom-archive-lantern.name: Archive lantern
custom-archive-lantern.description: First-clear keepsake from the Cinder Archive. Its light carries no new targeting rule.

field-tonic.name: Field tonic
field-tonic.description: Restore 35 HP to a living ally. Uses the active ally's action; does not revive or cleanse.

vital-tonic.name: Vital tonic
vital-tonic.description: Restore 70 HP to a living ally. Stronger medicine at a higher price.

ether-draught.name: Ether draught
ether-draught.description: Restore 18 energy to a living ally. Uses an action and cannot exceed maximum energy.

deep-ether.name: Deep ether
deep-ether.description: Restore 32 energy to a living ally. Uses an action.

cleansing-salts.name: Cleansing salts
cleansing-salts.description: Clear burn, slow, exposure and soaking from a living ally. Does not heal or grant guard.

phoenix-seed.name: Phoenix seed
phoenix-seed.description: Revive a fallen ally at 30 HP, capped by maximum health. Uses an action; statuses are unchanged.

shrine.name: The shrine of Veyr
shrine.subtitle: Contract I · The broken promise
shrine.description: Secure the first shard from an Oathless patrol. The causeway offers the safest crossing; ice can open another route.

causeway.name: The drowned causeway
causeway.subtitle: Contract II · A road beneath water
causeway.description: The retreating patrol has flooded the lower crossing. Two mobile outriders screen an elemental caster and a healer across the stream.

redoubt.name: The Cinder Archive
redoubt.subtitle: Emberwarden mission / The names we keep
redoubt.description: The archive wardens guard the surviving flood records. Climb the terraces, separate their healer from the line, and defeat all six defenders. Shelves and lanterns are scenery.

bellkeeper.name: The silent belfry
bellkeeper.subtitle: Contract IV · The last bell
bellkeeper.description: Orren, the Bellkeeper, guards the crown seal in a raised courtyard. At half health he breaks his oath: cleansing burn and slow, restoring energy, gaining speed and advancing his next turn. Defeat him and his three retainers.

shrine.speaker: narrator
shrine.text: Secure the first shard from an Oathless patrol. The causeway offers the safest crossing; ice can open another route.

shrine.speaker: sera
shrine.text: A crown is only a promise. Let’s see who it was made to.

causeway.speaker: narrator
causeway.text: The retreating patrol has flooded the lower crossing. Two mobile outriders screen an elemental caster and a healer across the stream.

causeway.speaker: sera
causeway.text: A crown is only a promise. Let’s see who it was made to.

redoubt.speaker: narrator
redoubt.text: Beyond the weir, the Cinder Archive rises in three stone terraces. The last flood records lie behind the wardens' line.

redoubt.speaker: enemy-cinder-clock-cinder-archive
redoubt.text: Every name in these books paid for its place. Why should yours be different?

redoubt.speaker: sera
redoubt.text: We came for the names the river took. The terraces give them height, so take one step at a time.

redoubt.speaker: corin
redoubt.text: I'll draw the runner south. Keep their mender from patching the whole line.

redoubt.speaker: mae
redoubt.text: Hearthguard cleanses burn. Save an action to protect whoever crosses the last stair.

bellkeeper.speaker: narrator
bellkeeper.text: Orren, the Bellkeeper, guards the crown seal in a raised courtyard. At half health he breaks his oath: cleansing burn and slow, restoring energy, gaining speed and advancing his next turn. Defeat him and his three retainers.

bellkeeper.speaker: sera
bellkeeper.text: A crown is only a promise. Let’s see who it was made to.
